difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a set-valued functor whose values satisfy two covering conditions gives a sheaf-valued direct image, an adjunction with the stalk functor, and the equality between the stalks of a presheaf and of its sheafification (statement lines 8199-8217). The proof is short but complete: the first assertion follows from the definition of a sheaf together with the two assumptions (proof lines 8220-8221); the second restricts the known adjointness to sheaves (proof lines 8221-8223); and the third follows from a chain of adjunction identifications comparing the maps out of the two stalks (proof lines 8224-8231). The non-formal content is the comparison of the stalks through adjunctions. The claim is H1: three short verifications, each written out.
